text:
Ava (Marketing): Uploaded draft v3 for the launch post: https://docs.redwood.ai/drafts/serve-launch-v3 — need quick pass on claims + CTA.
Sam (Content): Skimming. Lede still feels soft. Suggest: 1-line hook then metric.
Diego (Product): Add a concise benchmark line: 'up to 3.2x lower per-token latency vs our previous deployment (internal test)'. I'll drop run link.
Ava (Marketing): Please paste link for legal.
Diego (Product): https://bench.redwood.ai/runs/serve-v3-2026 — full config + raw numbers in run notes.
Priya (Legal): Thanks. Use 'up to' not absolutes. Footnote with the run link is required. Also small wording tweak on data retention sentence.
Marisol (Design): Hero art ready in Figma (serve-hero-v3). Alt text suggestion: 'Chart: latency & throughput improvements on Redwood Dedicated'. Need final CTA microcopy for button.
Noah (Growth): CTA idea: 'See benchmarks & reserve webinar spot' — will wire HubSpot flow and gating.
Ava (Marketing): Speakers for webinar: Ava + Diego + Tyler (Infra). Tyler confirmed May 12.
PublishBot: preview build: https://preview.redwood.ai/blog/serve-launch-v3 status: SUCCESS
Sam (Content): tightened lead to one sentence and added subhead 'Predictable inference at scale'. Moved demo earlier.
Priya (Legal): I left one doc comment about retention phrasing — small edit. Otherwise legal OK with the benchmark footnote.
Diego (Product): Approve benchmark phrasing as written.
Marisol (Design): Final CTA text: 'See benchmarks & join webinar' — assets uploaded to /assets/serve-launch-v3.
Noah (Growth): HubSpot form created: form_7052. Mapping set: registrants -> webinar list, gated_pdf -> download. Will add UTM params.
Ava (Marketing): Plan: push final draft at 10:00 PT, schedule publish at 13:00 PT. If no blockers by 12:30 PT we go live.
Priya (Legal): Resolved my doc comment. Legal green.
Ava (Marketing): Thanks all — proceeding to publish. :rocket:
